Which statement about the bonding in sodium chloride is correct?
A
The sodium and chlorine atoms share pairs of electrons.
B
The chlorine atoms give electrons to the sodium atoms to form positive and negative ions.
C
There is covalent bonding between sodium and chlorine.
D
The positive and negative ions have noble gas electronic configurations.

options.label: A

options.label: B
